sam: Heads-up: runtime 3.4 canary shows intermittent p99 spikes on short-batch gen (models: rdx-lite). Not crashes, just tails. Should we pin or scoped-unpin? :thinking:
nora: Data: p95 steady, p99 up ~60ms during bursts. Affects only small payloads.
diego: SDK telemetry: two internal services still pin runtime=3.3. If we unpin cluster-wide we risk those failing negotiation.
marta: Suggest pinlist patch: pin rdx-lite to 3.3 for 6h, run targeted warmups on pinned pool, and open infra debug window.
deploybot: pinlist dry-run:
``napply: preview
model: rdx-lite -> runtime:3.3 expires:6h
estimated_hosts: 5
```
infra-bot: Noted. We'll check NIC/malloc churn and KV cache misses on those hosts.
sam: Decision: apply model-level pin to 3.3 for 6h, warm-up job now, alert thresholds p99>140ms or error-rate>0.15%. Diego/Marta own rollback. Nora update dashboards and docs.
diego: Applying pin now. Command: `deploybot apply-pinlist --file=pin-7912340000.yaml`
marta: Warm-up invoked: `kubectl -n redwood run warm --image=tools/warm:latest --env=MODEL=rdx-lite --replicas=4`
nora: Dashboards updated, alert rule added.
sam: Recording in release notes: "Canary: runtime 3.4 p99 tail on rdx-lite; temporary pin to 3.3 for 6h; infra debug ongoing." Reconvene in 30m.
